Job Summary
Vehant Technologies is hiring a Junior Web Developer with 1 to 3 years of experience to contribute to the front-end and back-end development of our web-based security and analytics platforms.
In this role, you will work closely with Senior Developers, Web Architects, and UI/UX designers to implement features, build responsive user interfaces, design RESTful APIs, and assist in maintaining clean, secure, and performant web applications. This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate developer looking to sharpen their full-stack engineering skills, learn modern web security standards, and work with real-time web applications.


Key Responsibilities
  • Full-Stack Feature Development: Develop, test, and maintain responsive web application features using ReactJS, NodeJS, and TypeScript.
  • API Database Integration: Build and consume RESTful APIs, integrate WebSockets for real-time data updates, and write optimized SQL queries for PostgreSQL / MySQL databases.
  • UI/UX Implementation: Translate Figma/UI designs into clean, responsive, and cross-browser-compatible front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, and modern CSS frameworks/component libraries.
  • Code Quality Best Practices: Write well-structured, readable, and reusable code while adhering to established coding standards, git workflows, and unit testing practices.
  • Web Security Hygiene: Follow secure coding practices to prevent common web vulnerabilities (XSS, SQL injection, CSRF) and handle user authentication flows (JWT, OAuth2).
  • Bug Fixing Optimization: Debug, troubleshoot, and fix technical issues reported in production or testing environments to improve performance and stability.


Required Skills Qualifications
  • Experience: 1 to 3 years of professional hands-on web development experience.
  • Core Tech Stack: Solid proficiency in ReactJS, NodeJS, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript, along with HTML5 and CSS3.
  • State Management: Hands-on experience with state management libraries/tools (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Context API).
  • Databases: Practical experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL), including writing basic queries, joins, and schema operations.
  • APIs WebSockets: Good understanding of RESTful API principles, JSON data formats, and basic knowledge of WebSockets for real-time communication.
  • Version Control: Familiarity with Git (branching, merging, pull requests) and Agile team workflows.
  • Security Basics: Awareness of fundamental web security concepts (HTTPS, JWT, CORS, basic OWASP awareness).


Preferred Qualifications
  • Familiarity with container tools like Docker or basic deployment pipelines (CI/CD).
  • Exposure to automated testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress).
  • Understanding of modern UI frameworks (Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or Ant Design).
  • Passion for learning new web technologies, serverless architecture, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).

Job Summary

Position Title: React Frontend Developer. Number of Openings: 1. Location: India (Hybrid). Target Start Date: ASAP.

Position Summary Fresh Gravity is seeking an experienced React Frontend Developer Contractor to join our clients AI-Ready Data Team. This role sits at the intersection of frontend engineering, data platform integration, cloud technologies, and enterprise-grade security, supporting the development of high-impact digital products used. The successful candidate will bring 5-6 years of professional frontend development experience, with strong expertise in React.js, modern JavaScript frameworks, cloud integrations, and secure enterprise application development. This individual will play a key role in shaping scalable frontend architecture, driving technical excellence, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business-critical digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Frontend Development Architecture - Design, develop, and maintain responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js and modern JavaScript frameworks.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Lead the implementation of scalable UI architecture patterns and reusable component libraries aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Collaborate closely with UX/UI designers to translate wireframes and prototypes into production-ready solutions.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Establish frontend coding standards and contribute to architectural decisions.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices, maintainability standards, and security requirements.
  • Frontend Development Architecture - Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance across frontend initiatives.
  • Data Platform Integration - Integrate frontend applications with Snowflake data platforms and AWS cloud services.
  • Data Platform Integration - Develop advanced dashboards and data visualization solutions supporting analytics and reporting use cases.
  • Data Platform Integration - Implement real-time data streaming and dynamic user experiences.
  • Data Platform Integration - Collaborate with backend and data engineering teams to design efficient data consumption patterns.
  • Data Platform Integration - Work extensively with RESTful APIs and GraphQL services to fetch, transform, and present enterprise data securely.
  • Security Authentication - Design and implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms including OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, and SSO.
  • Security Authentication - Ensure compliance with clients security standards, data governance policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Security Authentication - Integrate applications with enterprise identity providers and access management platforms.
  • Security Authentication - Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and frontend security best practices.
  • Security Authentication - Partner with security teams to identify and remediate application vulnerabilities.
  • Collaboration Agile Delivery - Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives.
  • Collaboration Agile Delivery - Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product managers, architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders across global regions.
  • Collaboration Agile Delivery - Contribute to technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Collaboration Agile Delivery - Stay current with emerging frontend technologies and recommend improvements that enhance product quality and developer productivity.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • 5-6 years of hands-on professional experience in React.js development.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise-grade web applications in complex environments.
  • Proven expertise with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web development.
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery teams.

Core Technical Skills

  • React.js: Advanced proficiency in React Hooks, Context API, Redux, component lifecycle, performance optimization, and reusable component design
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Snowflake and AWS services including S3, Lambda, API Gateway, and CloudFront
  • UI Architecture: Proven experience designing scalable frontend architecture, design systems, component libraries, and frontend frameworks
  • Authentication Authorization: Strong experience implementing OAuth 2.0, JWT, SAML, SSO, RBAC, and enterprise identity integrations
  • Development Tooling: Expertise with Webpack, Babel, npm/yarn, Git, CI/CD tools, and modern frontend build pipelines
  • APIs: Extensive experience integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services
  • Responsive Design: Strong knowledge of responsive design, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong experience with TypeScript in large-scale React applications.
  • Experience with testing frameworks including Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, and Playwright.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with data visualization technologies such as D3.js, Chart.js, Plotly, or Recharts.
  • Understanding of microservices architecture and API gateway patterns.
  • Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to AWS serverless architectures and cloud-native application development.
  • Prior experience within pharmaceutical, healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries is highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, and GxP environments.
  • Experience operating within global Agile delivery models.

Competencies Behaviorial Skills

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to diagnose complex technical challenges and deliver pragmatic solutions
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Leadership: Ability to influence technical decisions, mentor peers, and drive engineering best practices
  • Quality Mindset: High attention to detail with a commitment to code quality, maintainability, testing, and documentation
  • Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and global stakeholders
  • Continuous Learning: Proactive approach to learning new technologies and improving technical expertise
  • User-Centric Thinking: Strong understanding of UX principles, accessibility standards (WCAG), and inclusive design
  • Collaboration: Proven experience working effectively with globally distributed, cross-functional Agile teams

As Capability Manager Frontend Technologies, you own the teaching capability of every instructor delivering frontend content across our campus network. You are the gate between "hired" and "cleared to teach" — no instructor delivers a frontend session on your track without your certification.

This is a team leadership role with a strong hands-on technical core. You will lead a large, distributed group of frontend instructors spread across campuses — assessing their technical depth, running capability evaluations, closing skill gaps through targeted training, and keeping the instructor bench healthy enough to absorb absences and scale-ups without disrupting a single class.

You'll need to be genuinely strong in frontend engineering — you cannot evaluate what you cannot do yourself — and equally comfortable running structured operations, tracking data, and having direct conversations about performance.

Key Responsibilities

1. Instructor Capability Evaluation & Certification

  • Design and run technical capability evaluations for frontend instructors covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and applied project work.
  • Conduct mock teaching sessions and assess pedagogy alongside technical accuracy — concept clarity, board/screen work, error handling, and student Q&A response quality.
  • Certify instructors as deployment-ready for specific frontend subjects, and maintain the certification record for each instructor on your track.
  • Re-evaluate instructors periodically as curriculum and stack evolve, so certification never goes stale.

2. Bench Health & Backup Allocation

  • Own the frontend instructor queue: when a campus raises a backup request for an absent instructor, take ownership and allocate a certified replacement within the agreed turnaround time.
  • Maintain a live, accurate roster of certified frontend instructors, their campus mapping, subject coverage, and availability.
  • Forecast bench requirements against upcoming campus schedules and flag coverage risks before they become class cancellations.

3. Team Management

  • Lead and manage a large distributed team of frontend instructors across multiple campuses, holding each accountable to the defined delivery standard.
  • Run regular 1-on-1s and team reviews; set individual goals, track progress, and drive consistency of delivery across the group.
  • Handle escalations, conflicts, and day-to-day people issues within the instructor group, and act as their primary point of contact with the central academic team.
  • Build engagement and retention on the track — onboard new instructors well, keep strong performers motivated, and reduce attrition.

4. Training & Gap Closure

  • Identify capability gaps from evaluation data and student feedback, and design targeted upskilling interventions to close them.
  • Run onboarding and refresher training for frontend instructors on our internal learning portal.
  • Own Performance Improvement Plans for instructors falling below the quality bar — set clear criteria, run structured check-ins, and drive the outcome either way.

5. Quality Monitoring

  • Review post-class student feedback and assessment outcomes for frontend sessions; investigate consistently low-scoring instructors or subjects.
  • Sit in on live and recorded classes to audit delivery quality against the defined bar.
  • Report track-level capability and quality metrics to academic leadership on a regular cadence.

6. Content & Curriculum Support

  • Partner with the curriculum team to keep frontend content current with industry practice, and translate curriculum changes into instructor readiness plans.
  • Build evaluation rubrics, question banks, and reference delivery material for the frontend track.

7. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work with campus POCs, hiring, and program teams to keep instructor supply aligned with campus demand.
  • Support the hiring team on technical screening for frontend instructor roles.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience in frontend development, teaching, or a blended role.
  • Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Working proficiency in React — components, state management, hooks, routing.
  • Comfortable with responsive design, Git/GitHub, REST API integration, and browser dev tools.
  • Able to independently build and review production-quality frontend projects.

Functional

  • Proven team management experience — has directly led a sizeable team, owned their performance, run 1-on-1s and reviews, and handled hiring, escalations, and exits. This is non-negotiable for the role.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical skill in others — through interviewing, mentoring, code review, or training.
  • Structured and data-comfortable: can maintain rosters, track metrics, and work in spreadsheets and internal tools without hand-holding.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English; able to give direct, specific, actionable feedback.
  • High ownership and follow-through — this role is measured on whether classes run, not on effort spent.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Good to Have

  • Prior experience in an ed-tech, training, or academic-quality function.
  • Experience teaching or mentoring in a classroom or bootcamp setting.
  • Exposure to TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms and instructor performance tracking systems.

We are looking for Frontend Developers with 46 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining modern web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in modern frontend technologies such as React.js, Next.js, Angular, or Vue.js, along with a good understanding of responsive UI development, API integration, application performance, and frontend engineering best practices.

The candidate will be responsible for developing responsive and interactive web applications, integrating frontend applications with backend APIs and AI/data services, implementing reusable UI components, troubleshooting frontend issues, and collaborating closely with product, backend, AI/ML, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver high-quality applications.

The role will also involve working on modern web applications that may integrate AI/LLM capabilities, ensuring reliable presentation of AI-generated results, handling asynchronous workflows, validating frontend behavior across different scenarios, and contributing to application performance, usability, accessibility, and overall user experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into effective frontend solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, interactive, and user-friendly web applications using modern frontend frameworks.
  • Develop reusable and maintainable UI components using frameworks such as React.js, Next.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Implement responsive designs that work consistently across different browsers, screen sizes, and devices.
  • Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and backend services.
  • Handle API requests, responses, loading states, error states, validation, and asynchronous workflows effectively.
  • Integrate AI/ML/LLM-based services into frontend applications through APIs, SDKs, or other application interfaces where applicable.
  • Build user interfaces for AI-enabled functionality, including displaying AI-generated results, recommendations, classifications, extracted information, and agent responses.
  • Handle non-deterministic AI-generated outputs gracefully and ensure appropriate error, fallback, and exception handling within the user interface.
  • Develop reusable frontend utilities, components, hooks, services, and modules to improve development efficiency and consistency.
  • Implement client-side validation, state management, routing, form handling, and other core frontend functionality.
  • Ensure frontend applications meet performance, scalability, maintainability, and usability requirements.
  • Identify and resolve UI, functional, compatibility, performance, and integration-related defects.
  • Participate in requirement reviews, sprint planning, technical discussions, code reviews, and defect triage meetings.
  • Write clean, modular, readable, reusable, and well-documented code following established coding standards.
  • Perform unit testing and contribute to frontend test automation where applicable.
  • Work closely with QA engineers to troubleshoot defects and ensure adequate test coverage for frontend functionality.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to understand API contracts, data models, integration requirements, and error-handling scenarios.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML and product teams to ensure AI-driven functionality is presented accurately and effectively to end users.
  • Implement appropriate security practices in frontend applications, including secure handling of authentication, authorization, sessions, and sensitive information.
  • Use Git-based version control and participate in established branching, pull-request, and code-review practices.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated build, test, and deployment processes where applicable.
  • Troubleshoot application issues across development, testing, and production environments and provide detailed technical information for root-cause analysis.
  • Contribute to improving frontend development standards, reusable components, coding practices, application performance, and overall engineering efficiency.
  • Support release validation and provide inputs on frontend quality, functionality, usability, and release readiness.
  • Work effectively with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Backend Developers, AI/ML Engineers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and other cross-functional teams.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

  • 4-6 years of professional experience in frontend software development.
  • Strong hands-on experience in modern frontend development.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one modern frontend framework such as:
  • React.js
  • Next.js
  • Angular
  • Vue.js
  • Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Good understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript concepts including ES6+, asynchronous programming, promises, closures, modules, and event handling.
  • Experience building reusable, modular, and maintainable UI components.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with JSON-based request/response payloads.
  • Good understanding of API integration, error handling, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous data flows.
  • Experience with state management concepts and relevant libraries/framework capabilities.
  • Good understanding of frontend routing, forms, validation, and client-side data handling.
  • Experience with Git and standard source-control practices.
  • Good understanding of frontend build tools, package managers, and dependency management.
  • Experience working with browser developer tools for debugging and performance analysis.
  • Understanding of frontend testing practices and experience with relevant testing frameworks/tools is preferred.
  • Good understanding of software development methodologies, SDLC, and Agile/Scrum practices.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and automated build/deployment processes is preferred.
  • Good understanding of web application security principles and secure frontend development practices.
  • Experience working with cloud-hosted web applications is preferred.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML/LLM-based services into web applications is preferred.

Frontend & AI Application Development Experience

Candidates with experience working on modern web applications should be able to demonstrate practical knowledge of:

  • Developing responsive and interactive enterprise web applications.
  • Building reusable UI components and frontend modules.
  • Integrating frontend applications with REST APIs, GraphQL, and backend services.
  • Managing application state and asynchronous operations effectively.
  • Handling loading, error, empty, timeout, and exception scenarios in frontend applications.
  • Integrating AI/LLM-powered functionality into web applications through APIs or SDKs.
  • Displaying and handling AI-generated content, recommendations, classifications, extracted information, or agent responses.
  • Designing frontend experiences for AI-enabled workflows where outputs may be dynamic or non-deterministic.
  • Implementing appropriate loading, retry, fallback, and error-handling mechanisms for AI and API-driven features.
  • Validating that AI-generated or dynamically generated results are presented correctly and consistently to users.
  • Handling long-running or asynchronous AI/agent operations and providing appropriate user feedback.
  • Understanding the impact of API latency and AI processing time on user experience and frontend performance.
  • Building user interfaces that support complex business workflows and data-driven applications.
  • Identifying UI, functional, integration, performance, usability, and compatibility issues.
  • Debugging frontend issues using browser developer tools, logs, network inspection, and application monitoring tools.
  • Writing maintainable code and contributing to reusable frontend standards and component libraries.

About Eden Health

Eden Health is a US healthcare company delivering exceptional healthcare experiences through technology. Eden has set up a dedicated Engineering and Product Hub in India in partnership with Softobiz Technologies, to expand engineering capacity, speed up innovation and strengthen its AI and data capabilities.

We are now building the next version of Edens platform: a connected healthcare ecosystem that brings patients, doctors, care teams and partners such as clinics and pharmacies together on one modern, cloud-native foundation. The India hub is at the centre of that build.AI is central to how Eden will grow, from clinical decision support to operational automation. The India hub works hand in hand with Edens US leadership, with real ownership across product, engineering and operations.Read the announcement: Expanding Our Digital Footprint in India


About the role

We’re looking for developers who treat AI as the default way to build software. You will help build the next version of Eden’s platform end to end, use AI tools to move fast without cutting corners, and bring AI into the product where it genuinely makes things better for patients, doctors and care teams.This is a hands-on engineering role on a modern platform being built the right way from the ground up. You’ll be part of a small, high-ownership team where your work reaches real patients quickly.


What AI-first means here

  • Think AI: For any problem, you ask whether AI can solve it better, faster or cheaper. You can also tell when it shouldn’t be used.
  • Use AI: AI coding tools are part of how you plan, write, test, debug, refactor and document code every day.
  • Build AI: You can turn a good idea into a working AI feature when the opportunity is there.
  • Build apps: Solid engineering comes first. You ship clean, tested, secure, production-ready applications.

What you’ll do

Build the platform

  • Build end-to-end features across web apps, APIs and backend services.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and own it from design to production.
  • Build with security and privacy in mind, from access control to protecting patient data.
  • Improve performance, reliability and observability across the platform.
  • Work with product and design to turn requirements into working software quickly.

Bring AI into the product

  • Help design and build AI-powered features such as smart search, summarisation and assistants for patients and care teams.
  • Spot manual work across Support, Operations and Marketing that AI can automate, and help build the solutions.
  • Keep up with fast-moving AI tools and bring practical ideas to the team.

Ways of working

  • Use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar tools daily, and stay accountable for the quality of everything you merge.
  • Share what works: prompts, workflows and shortcuts that help the whole team move faster.
  • Take part in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, release planning and the production support rotation.
  • Handle patient data responsibly under HIPAA-aligned security and privacy practices.
  • Communicate clearly and asynchronously with US-based stakeholders.

Must have

  • 3 to 5 years of professional full stack development experience.
  • Strong skills in TypeScript, with React or Next.js on the front end and Node.js on the back end.
  • Solid experience with APIs, SQL databases and cloud platforms, ideally AWS.
  • AI-assisted coding as part of your daily workflow, with examples to show.
  • Some hands-on experience integrating AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini), at work or in side projects.
  • Good engineering habits: Git, CI/CD, automated testing and code reviews.
  • Clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • GraphQL, microservices or event-driven architectures.
  • Agent or automation tools such as LangChain, n8n or MCP servers.
  • Healthcare or another regulated domain.
  • A public portfolio, GitHub or side projects that show how you build.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • You’re shipping features independently across the full stack.
  • You’ve contributed to at least one AI-powered feature or automation that’s in use.
  • Your AI-assisted workflow is visibly raising the team’s pace and quality.
  • Teammates come to you for AI tooling ideas.

Why join

  • Help build the next version of a healthcare platform from the ground up.
  • Be part of the founding team of Eden’s India Engineering and Product Hub, with a real mandate to shape what comes next.
  • Join an AI-first culture where the best tools are part of how everyone works.
  • High ownership, fast feedback and visible impact.

How we’ll assess you

  • Show us something you built with AI, or something AI helped you build faster. Share a GitHub link, a demo or a short walkthrough with your application.
  • Expect a live build exercise where you use your own AI tools. We care about how you think, break down the problem and steer the AI, as much as the final result.
  • Expect a technical conversation with our engineering lead about your past work and decisions.

Job Title: Node.js Developer

Work Mode :- 5 days Work From Office Only

Skills Required: Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, REST APIs
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Node.js Developer with experience in MySQL database development to build, maintain, and optimize scalable server-side applications and RESTful APIs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend applications using Node.js and Express.js.
  • Design, develop, and optimize MySQL databases, tables, indexes, and queries.
  • Build and integrate RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications.
  • Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms.
  • Optimize application performance and database query execution.
  • Handle database transactions, joins, stored procedures, and data validation.
  • Debug issues, troubleshoot errors, and improve application reliability.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, QA engineers, and other team members.
  • Use Git for version control and follow coding best practices.

Required Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience with Express.js.
  • Good understanding of MySQL database design and SQL queries.
  • Experience with CRUD operations, joins, subqueries, indexes, and transactions.
  • Experience developing and consuming REST APIs.
  • Knowledge of asynchronous programming, Promises, and async/await.
  • Understanding of authentication using JWT or session-based mechanisms.
  • Familiarity with Git and GitHub/GitLab.
  • Basic knowledge of error handling, logging, and API security.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Sequelize, Prisma, or another Node.js ORM.
  • Knowledge of Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Redis, caching, and application performance optimization.
  • Knowledge of unit testing using Jest or Mocha.

Full Stack Developer (2-5 Year's Experience)


Company: Evenica India Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
Location: Remote / Work From Home
Working Hours: 9:00 AM 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET)
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Experience Required: 25 Years


About the Role

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with 2-5 years of professional experience to join our product engineering team and contribute to the development of modern, scalable, enterprise-grade applications.


This is a hands-on development role where you will work across frontend and backend technologies, primarily using React, Next.js, Node.js, and .NET Core. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, designers, and QA professionals to design, develop, test, and deliver high-quality software features.


The ideal candidate enjoys coding, solving technical challenges, learning new technologies, and taking ownership of assigned tasks while continuously improving their engineering skills.


Why Join Us

At Evenica, you will have the opportunity to work on real-world enterprise applications and develop your technical capabilities in a collaborative, quality-focused engineering environment.

We offer:

  • Opportunities to work on modern full-stack technologies and enterprise-scale applications.
  • Exposure to real production environments, technical challenges, and software development best practices.
  • Guidance and collaboration with experienced software engineers and technical leads.
  • Opportunities to contribute ideas, improve existing systems, and take increasing ownership of features.
  • A supportive environment that encourages continuous learning, technical growth, and independent problem-solving.

About the Team

You will be part of a focused product engineering team working closely with developers, technical leads, product managers, designers, QA professionals, and business stakeholders.

Our team follows collaborative development practices, including code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and continuous improvement.

You will contribute to building and maintaining features throughout the software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and writing code to testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.


What You'll Do

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, and/or .NET Core.
  • Build responsive, reusable, and maintainable frontend components.
  • Develop and integrate REST APIs and backend services.
  • Work with SQL databases to write queries, manage data, and support application functionality.
  • Understand functional requirements and translate them into working software solutions.
  • Write clean, readable, maintainable, and testable code following established development standards.
  • Debug application issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable fixes.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders to deliver features and resolve issues.
  • Write unit tests and support integration testing where applicable.
  • Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and technical discussions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for assigned features and changes.
  • Take ownership of assigned development tasks and communicate progress, challenges, and dependencies proactively.
  • Continuously improve technical knowledge, development practices, and problem-solving skills.

What We're Looking For


Core Technical Skills

  • 2 - 5 years of professional software development experience, preferably in full-stack application development.
  • Practical experience with React.js and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience with Next.js or similar React-based frameworks.
  • Experience in backend development using Node.js and/or C# .NET Core / ASP.NET Core.
  • Good understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web development.
  • Experience developing, integrating, and consuming REST APIs.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with database queries, joins, relationships, and basic schema design.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and application security fundamentals.
  • Experience using Git or similar version control systems.
  • Familiarity with debugging, error handling, logging, and application troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of object-oriented programming, software development principles, and clean coding practices.
  • Experience working on applications used in production environments.
  • Basic familiarity with unit testing and software quality practices.

Professional Skills & Ownership

  • Good analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Willingness to take responsibility for assigned tasks and deliver quality work.
  • Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks while seeking guidance when needed.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to code quality.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable collaborating with a distributed team and working remotely.
  • Openness to constructive feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to manage tasks, communicate progress, and meet agreed timelines.
  • Curiosity, initiative, and a genuine interest in software engineering.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a motivated full-stack developer with 25 years of experience building and supporting web applications.

They should be comfortable working with frontend frameworks, backend APIs, and relational databases, with a solid understanding of how different application components work together.

We value developers who:

  • Enjoy hands-on coding and technical problem-solving.
  • Focus on writing clean, reliable, and maintainable code.
  • Demonstrate initiative and accountability for their work.
  • Ask thoughtful questions and communicate challenges early.
  • Are eager to learn from experienced engineers and improve their skills.
  • Can gradually take greater ownership of features as their experience grows.

Nice to Have

The following skills are beneficial but not mandatory:

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, including App Services, Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, or similar services.
  • Exposure to AWS, Google Cloud, or other cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Experience with headless CMS platforms such as Contentful, Sanity, or Sitecore.
  • Familiarity with Docker or containerized applications.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.
  • Exposure to performance optimization, application monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, a successful candidate will:

  • Develop a good understanding of the application's architecture, technologies, and development workflows.
  • Independently complete assigned development tasks with appropriate guidance.
  • Deliver reliable, well-tested features and bug fixes.
  • Demonstrate consistent improvement in code quality, debugging, and technical problem-solving.
  • Participate effectively in code reviews, technical discussions, and team activities.
  • Communicate progress, dependencies, and challenges proactively.
  • Build the confidence and technical ability to take increasing ownership of application features.

Work Setup

Location: Work From Home / Remote
Working Hours: 9:00 AM 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), aligned with North American business hours
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Experience: 25 Years

Candidates must be comfortable working during Eastern Time business hours and collaborating with geographically distributed teams.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and technical capabilities.
  • Full-time remote working opportunity.
  • Exposure to enterprise-grade applications and modern engineering technologies.
  • Opportunities to work across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and cloud environments.
  • Learning and development through collaboration with experienced engineers.
  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for career growth into senior engineering and technical leadership roles.
  • A culture that values accountability, engineering quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Application Process

Our interview process typically includes:

  1. Initial Screening: A discussion about your professional experience, technical background, communication skills, and role expectations.
  2. Technical Interview: An evaluation of your practical knowledge of frontend development, backend development, APIs, databases, and problem-solving.
  3. Practical Assessment: A coding exercise, technical discussion, or code review to assess coding ability, logical thinking, and development practices.
  4. Final Discussion: A conversation to align on expectations, work setup, compensation, and team fit.

How to Apply

If you are a motivated Full Stack Developer with 2-5 years of experience who enjoys building reliable applications, solving technical challenges, and continuously improving your engineering skills, we would love to hear from you.


Please submit your application directly through Naukri Portal with your updated resume highlighting your relevant technical skills, professional experience, and projects.


You are also welcome to include links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of previous work that demonstrate your technical capabilities.


Please ensure you are comfortable working remotely during Eastern Time (ET) business hours before applying.


We look forward to learning more about your experience and exploring how you could contribute to our engineering team.

Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Managers and other Engineers to help define, scope, and implement high-quality features that solve critical user needs.
  • Break down requirements into architecture and deliver code, while keeping operational issues in mind.
  • The ability to own end-to-end responsibility right from the requirement to release.
  • Write clear documentation so that other engineers can jump in and get things done.
  • Actively participate in design and code reviews.
  • Help take Tracxn to the next level as a world-class engineering team

Job Requirements

  • Experience with building backend services. Strong algorithm and CS skills.
  • 2+ years of experience designing and implementing largescale distributed systems.
  • Experience with multiple programming languages (Groovy, Java) and data stores
  • (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc)
  • Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, agile, and in ownership, and results-oriented culture.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Culture

  • Work with performance-oriented teams driven by ownership and passion.
  • Learn to design systems for high accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
  • No strict deadlines focus on delivering quality work.
  • Meritocracy-driven, candid culture. No politics.
  • Very high visibility regarding which startups and markets are exciting globally.

About Tracxn

Tracxn (Tracxn.com) is a Bangalore-based product company providing a research and deal sourcing platform for Venture Capital, Private Equity, Corp Dev, and professionals working around the startup ecosystem. We are a team of 600+ working professionals serving customers across the globe. Our clients include Funds like Andreessen Horowitz, Matrix Partners, GGV Capital, and Large Corporates such as Citi, Embraer &

Ferrero.


Founders

  • Neha Singh (ex-Sequoia, BCG | MBA - Stanford GSB)
  • Abhishek Goyal (ex-Accel Partners, Amazon | BTech - IIT Kanpur)

About Technology Team


Tracxn's Technology team is 50+ members strong and growing. The technology team is subdivided into multiple smaller teams, each of which owns one or more services/components of the technology platform. Ours is a young team of motivated engineers with a minimal management structure where almost everyone is actively involved in technical development and design activities. We have a team-centric culture where the ownership and responsibility of a feature or module lie with a team as compared to an individual.


We work on an array of technologies, including but not limited to ReactJS, Next.js, Storybook, Webpack, Node, Mongo, AWS Lambda, Spring, Elastic Stack, MySQL, Kafka, Redis, Ansible, etc.


We value ownership, continuous learning, consistency, and discipline as a team.

We are looking for a skilled **Full Stack Product Engineer** who is passionate about building scalable software products and leveraging AI-powered development tools to accelerate product development, improve code quality, and solve complex technical challenges.


## Key Responsibilities


- Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications.

- Build responsive web interfaces using Angular and cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter.

- Develop robust back-end services using Java and Spring Boot.

- Leverage AI models and AI-powered coding tools to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and code optimization.

- Develop and integrate REST APIs and third-party services.

- Design, optimize, and maintain databases, including schema design and query performance tuning.

- Take end-to-end ownership of product features, from requirement analysis through development, testing, deployment, and production support.

- Troubleshoot bugs, resolve production issues, and improve application performance.

- Collaborate with product managers, UI/UX designers, QA engineers, and other developers.

- Write clean, maintainable, reusable, secure, and well-documented code.

- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.

- Ensure application security, reliability, scalability, and data integrity.


## Required Technical Skills


**1. AI-Assisted Development**

- Hands-on experience using AI models and AI-powered development tools such as Claude, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or equivalent tools.

- Ability to use AI tools for code generation, refactoring, debugging, test case creation, and technical documentation.

- Ability to validate AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.


**2. Backend Development**

- Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot or equivalent back-end technologies.

- Experience developing and integrating RESTful APIs.

- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.


**3. Frontend Development**

- Hands-on experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.

- Ability to build responsive, user-friendly, and maintainable web applications.


**4. Mobile Application Development**

- Experience with Flutter and Dart for cross-platform Android and iOS application development.


**5. Database and Tools**

- Strong knowledge of MySQL or PostgreSQL.

- Experience with Git, version control, debugging, and code reviews.

- Experience with application deployment, server configuration, and production troubleshooting.


## Good to Have


- Experience developing SaaS products or enterprise applications.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Azure or AWS.

- Experience with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.

- Knowledge of Android/iOS integrations and mobile application deployment.

- Experience with POS systems, payment gateways, online ordering, or third-party API integrations.

- Understanding of offline-first applications, data synchronization, application monitoring, and performance optimization.


## Qualifications


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 36 years of relevant software development experience.

- Practical experience in full-stack development, with Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and Flutter.

- Experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools into everyday engineering workflows.

- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and take end-to-end ownership of product features.


## What We Offer


- Opportunity to build and improve a growing restaurant technology product.

- Ownership of features that directly impact real-world restaurant operations.

- A collaborative and technically challenging work environment.

- Opportunities to work with modern AI tools, cloud technologies, mobile applications, and third-party integrations.


## How to Apply


Interested candidates can share their updated CV along with their current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and earliest joining date.

We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong backend experience with Java and hands-on experience with Python or JavaScript, along with frontend expertise in React.js or Next.js.

The candidate should also have strong experience developing RESTful APIs and working with OpenShift (OCP), Docker, and Kubernetes environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full-stack applications.
  • Develop backend services and business logic using Java.
  • Work with Python or JavaScript for backend services, scripting, automation, or application development.
  • Develop modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js or Next.js.
  • Design, develop, integrate, and consume RESTful APIs.
  • Implement API authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, and logging.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend REST APIs.
  • Develop reusable and maintainable UI components.
  • Work with databases and optimize queries and application performance.
  • Containerize applications using Docker.
  • Deploy and manage applications using Kubernetes and OpenShift (OCP).
  • Troubleshoot application, container, deployment, and production issues.
  • Implement unit, integration, and API testing.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
  • Work with Git/GitHub for source control and collaborative development.
  • Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated application deployments.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of overall software development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java.
  • Good experience with at least one of the following:
    • Python
    • JavaScript

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer with strong expertise in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Kubernetes to design, develop, and maintain scalable, responsive, and high-performance consumer-facing web applications.

Roles & Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Consumer UI: Build fast, responsive, accessible experiences for home buyers, sellers and renters, such as search, listing details, saved homes and lead forms, as Next.js micro-frontends (web islands).
  • Components and design system: Build reusable components and contribute to realtor.com's shared design system and component library.
  • Data integration: Consume GraphQL (from a federated supergraph) and REST APIs, and handle errors and loading states.
  • Performance and accessibility: Own Core Web Vitals, SEO-friendly rendering and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance.
  • Experimentation: Implement A/B tests and analytics tracking.

Must have

  • 5+ years of frontend engineering, with strong React and TypeScript.
  • Experience with Next.js or other server-side rendering.
  • Strong HTML, CSS and JavaScript fundamentals; responsive design; WCAG accessibility.
  • GraphQL client and REST integration.
  • Build tooling (Webpack, Babel or Vite) and state-management patterns.
  • Testing with Jest and React Testing Library, plus E2E testing with Playwright or Cypress.
  • Cross-browser debugging and performance optimization (Core Web Vitals).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI, GitHub Actions or similar) and containerized deployment (Docker) to Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Hands-on Kubernetes (K8s) basics for your own app: reading pod logs, tuning Helm values, checking ArgoCD sync status and rolling back a bad release.

Good to have

  • CSS-in-JS (e.g. styled-components) and design-system contributions.
  • Real-estate or marketplace domain experience; React Native.
  • Micro-frontends, Nx or Lerna monorepos, Storybook.
  • Some Node.js/TypeScript backend exposure.
  • Modernizing legacy frontends; SEO for server-rendered pages.
  • Experience working on an internal developer platform / paved-path model (standard Helm charts, service templates, self-service deployments).
  • New Relic Browser, SpeedCurve or other real-user monitoring; Splunk.

Experimentation and analytics tooling (Amplitude, Optimizely).

Skills To Be Evaluated On

React.js,Nextjs,TypeScript,React Testing Library,AWS,GraphgQL

Position: Python Full Stack Developer
Experience: 5 to 15 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking highly skilled and experienced Python Full Stack Developers to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and enterprise solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python backend development along with modern frontend technologies, cloud platforms, APIs, and microservices architecture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable web applications using Python and modern frontend frameworks.
  • Develop robust backend services, RESTful APIs, and microservices using Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
  • Build responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular, React.js, or Vue.js.
  • Integrate applications with databases, third-party services, and cloud platforms.
  • Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design sessions.
  • Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, architects, and QA teams.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions.

Required Skills

Backend Technologies

  • Strong experience in Python development.
  • Expertise in one or more frameworks:
    • Django
    • Flask
    • FastAPI
  • Experience in API development and integration.
  • Knowledge of Microservices Architecture.

Frontend Technologies

  • Experience with:
    • React.js
    • Angular
  • Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Responsive UI development experience.

Database Skills

  • Strong experience with:
    • PostgreSQL
    • MySQL
    • MongoDB
  • Database design, query optimization, and performance tuning.

Cloud & DevOps

  • Experience with cloud platforms:
    • AWS
    • Azure
    • GCP
  • CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI.
  • Containerization using Docker and Kubernetes.

Version Control & Tools

  • Git/GitHub/GitLab
  • JIRA, Confluence
  • Agile/Scrum methodologies

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Event-Driven Architecture.
  • Knowledge of Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ.
  • Exposure to Serverless technologies.
  • Experience with AI/ML integrations and Generative AI applications.
  • Understanding of security best practices and OWASP standards.
  • Experience working in enterprise-scale environments.

Job_Description":"
Digital Areo Pvt Ltd is hiring a Senior Web Application Developer with 4-6 years of experience in React and Next.js to develop modern, scalable web applications for a Taxi and Transport Operations Platform.
The selected candidate will be responsible for developing booking interfaces, dispatch dashboards, driver and customer management screens, and administrative modules.
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop responsive web applications using Next.js, React and JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Build booking forms, dispatch dashboards, operational interfaces and administrative screens.
  • Integrate frontend applications with ASP.NET Core REST APIs.
  • Implement form validation, loading states, error handling and user-friendly workflows.
  • Develop real-time operational updates using SignalR or WebSockets.
  • Implement role-based navigation and permission-aware interfaces.
  • Build reusable components and maintain consistent UI standards.
  • Optimize application performance, accessibility and responsiveness.
  • Write frontend unit and component tests.
  • Collaborate with backend and mobile development teams to ensure seamless integration.


    Requirements
    Required Qualifications
    • 4-6 years of professional frontend development experience.
    • Strong hands-on experience with React and Next.js.
    • Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3.
    • Experience with routing, component architecture and state management.
    • Strong understanding of REST API integration and asynchronous operations.
    • Experience developing responsive and cross-browser-compatible applications.
    • Familiarity with Git, code reviews, debugging and frontend testing.
    • Ability to independently develop and maintain production-ready web applications.
      Preferred Qualifications
      • Experience with TypeScript and modern frontend development tools.
      • Knowledge of SignalR, WebSockets and real-time dashboards.
      • Experience integrating Google Maps or other mapping SDKs.
      • Previous experience developing booking, logistics, transportation or operations management platforms.
      • Understanding of accessibility, frontend security and performance optimization.


        Benefits
        • Opportunity to work on a modern transport technology platform.
        • Exposure to scalable, real-time web application development.
        • Collaborative and professional development environment.
        • Opportunity to take ownership of key application modules.
        • Professional growth and continuous technical learning.
        • Competitive salary based on experience and technical expertise.

" Job Description
TechMojo is looking for a Frontend Angular Developer, with at least 3+ years of Angular experience, responsible for the client side of our service. Your primary focus will be to implement a complete user interface in the form of a web application, with a focus on performance. Your main duties will include creating modules and components and coupling them together into a functional app. The artistic design will be delivered to you, together with a few HTML templates, but we will ask for your help in regard to animations, CSS, and final HTML output. You will work in a team with the back-end developer and communicate with the API using standard methods. A thorough understanding of all of the components of our platform and infrastructure is required.

Required Skills -
  • 4-5 years of demonstrated proficiency in developing advanced web applications using Angular.
  • In-depth expertise in TypeScript and JavaScript, with a solid foundation in object-oriented programming.
  • Strong grasp of HTML and CSS principles, enabling effective collaboration with designers and UI/UX experts.
  • Proven experience in Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and its impact on application performance and SEO.
  • Track record of performance tuning and optimizing complex applications for speed and responsiveness.
  • Extensive knowledge of advanced Angular concepts, such as dynamic components, custom directives, and advanced routing.
  • Experience in identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks using tools like Chrome DevTools and Webpack Bundle Analyzer.
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and code collaboration tools.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze and debug intricate technical challenges.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • A continuous learning mindset with a commitment to staying updated with emerging trends and technologies in the Angular ecosystem.

    Responsibilities -
  • Delivering a complete front-end application
  • Ensuring high performance on mobile and desktop
  • Writing tested, idiomatic, and documented JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Coordinating the workflow between the graphic designer, the HTML coder, and yourself
  • Cooperating with the back-end developer in the process of building the RESTful API
  • Communicating with external web services

  • Proficiency with JavaScript, Typescript, CSS and HTML
  • Professional, precise communication skills
  • Deep knowledge of Angular practices and commonly used modules based on extensive work experience.
  • Creating self-contained, reusable, and testable modules and components
  • Ensuring a clear dependency chain, in regard to the app logic as well as the file system
  • Ability to provide SEO solutions for single page apps.
  • Extensive knowledge of CSS and JS methods for providing performant visual effects and keeping the framerate above 30fps at all times
  • Thorough understanding of the responsibilities of the platform, database, API, caching layer, proxies, and other web services used in the system.
  • Validating user actions on the client side and providing responsive feedback
  • Writing non-blocking code, and resorting to advanced techniques such as multi-threading, when needed
  • Creating custom, general-use modules, and components which extend the elements and modules of core Angular.
  • Experience with all levels of operation available to the front-end, such as from creating XHRs in vanilla JS to using a custom wrapper around resource.
  • Experience with building the infrastructure for serving the front-end app and assets.
  • Architecting and automating the build process for production, using task runners or scripts
  • Documenting the code inline using JSDoc or other conventions
  • Writing extensive unit tests using automated TDD tasks
  • Creating e2e test suites for all components, and running them with Protractor (or a well-reasoned alternative)
  • Creating configuration, build, and test scripts for Continuous Integration environments
  • Atleast 3+ years of hands-on coding on Angular is a must.

    The position is based in Hyderabad and requires working from the office.
